items.question: Which glorious five-weapon-bearing deity is called Viṣṇu by the wise?
items.inference: The wise name the glorious five-weapon bearer Viṣṇu.
uncertainties: Compendium quotation boundary is not marked in this verse.
items.plain_english: The glorious Viṣṇu, bearer of five weapons, is thus called by the wise.
